purpose: Independent service review for Wiesbaden official cadastral and parcel-oriented map sources.
assessment: Wiesbaden has an evidenced municipal geoinformation custodian and the state ALKIS WFS returned safe parcel geometry with stable native oids. Two full polygons are retained in wiesbaden-parcel-samples.geojson. Runtime readiness remains held pending serial review because the bounded sample does not prove citywide completeness or adapter suitability.
registryAssessment: The Wiesbaden Geoportal and municipal product page identify the Tiefbau- und Vermessungsamt/Geoinformation as the local geoinformation custodian. The parcel data itself is provided by the Hessian state cadastral authority through the official ALKIS WFS; this is local/state cadastral evidence, not title or ownership evidence.

attempts: Ran separate English and German first-party discovery queries.
Reviewed the official Wiesbaden Geoportal and municipal Geoportal description; the city viewer page advertises map feature querying but its shell GET timed out after 20 seconds.
Fetched official Hessen ALKIS WFS GetCapabilities anonymously over TLS; verified WFS 2.0, ave:Flurstueck, and service schema.
Executed a bounded anonymous ave:Flurstueck GetFeature request near the immutable WUP point in EPSG:25832; received HTTP 200 and three GML features.
Inspected the returned schema and retained only oid plus full geometry for two features; source-specific attributes, addresses, and all unsafe fields were excluded.
Did not log in, use credentials or private tokens, defeat access controls, request owner/titleholder/personal/tax data, or shift the WUP coordinate.
